d:
"Melodies of Mastery: Ustad Vilayat Khan Jukebox" presents an enchanting compilation of timeless musical treasures by the legendary sitar maestro, Ustad Vilayat Khan. From soulful renditions of classical ragas to mesmerizing improvisations, this jukebox showcases the unparalleled mastery of one of the greatest sitar players of all time.
